name: Belentani
description: An immersive artistic universe and a multimedia ecosystem that functions as a creative operating system. This platform fuses the dark textures of dark pop, visceral R&B, and experimental electronics with cutting-edge artificial intelligence tools. In this digital space, betrayal is transformed into an algorithm and healing becomes a conceptual hack. Through a narrative of transformation and redemption, the website invites users to explore a comprehensive body of work that connects music, cinematic visuals, and an interactive neural network studio. Here, visitors are not mere spectators, but part of a complete sensory experience where they can interact with the project's creative code. This is not a traditional artist's website; it is access to a frequency.
